text: “He has flown over the wall!” Mary cried out, watching him. “He has flown into the orchard—he has flown across the other wall—into the garden where there is no door!” “He lives there,” said old Ben. “He came out o’ th’ egg there. If he’s courtin’, he’s makin’ up to some young madam of a robin that lives among th’ old rose-trees there.” “Rose-trees,” said Mary. “Are there rose-trees?” Ben Weatherstaff took up his spade again and began to dig.
